sourceAccessibilityNotes.result: Web fetch returned 404; Brunei island status independently verified from the official MFA national profile linked in sourceChecks instead.
Web fetch failed; Palestine Mediterranean coast independently corroborated by a separate accessible 2024 UNCTAD report and UNEP Gaza coastline report search text.
Primary search-indexed report text explicitly describes Mediterranean Sea off Gaza’s shore; full web open returned 403.

limitations: Independent border review compared every country with a separately maintained aggregate, then used primary sources for discrepancies and sensitive cases. This is not 195 separately researched national boundary histories.

Land-area and population predicates were checked against independently downloaded World Bank snapshots for all 194 available countries and official Vatican figures. These are dated snapshot facts, not a claim of current population.

Sea/coast and island membership was reviewed by source groups covering every positive catalog membership. Conservative geographic match lists are not exhaustive answer sets; possibleExtraMatches are uncertainty allowances used only for fairness upper bounds.

The UN M49 regional scheme is a convention, especially for transcontinental countries and European subdivisions. Positive In Asia/Europe facts do not imply that all territory lies on only one continent.

Indian Ocean clue explicitly includes its marginal seas; Pacific coast follows FAO marginal-sea classification. The North Sea clue assigns direct North Sea coasts and reserves Sweden only as an upper-bound possibility.
World-map PDF requests that failed were not visually inspected and were not treated as independent proof. Source accessibility failures were corroborated with independent primary alternatives.
